Targets.doc:
What each section type needs, without touching a browser: its subjects
(defaults, a real instance, or a configured override), the fingerprinted
filename, and whether the picture on disk is still current.

FieldsetImage.doc:
Writes a set's `image:` back into whichever fieldset YAML defines it —
read from disk right before writing, never from a copy held in memory.

facade_doc_extra:
This class runs the browser and writes the files; what to shoot comes
from `SetPreview\Targets`, and the fieldset's `image:` is updated by
`SetPreview\FieldsetImage`. Split in WP7d, code moved verbatim.
